Class PlayerActions

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.PlayerActions
public final class PlayerActions extends Object
Things players do in the economy mods, reported for other mods to count (the Quests mod builds its achievements and quests on them). A mod reports with fire(UUID, String, long); nothing happens when no one listens. Listeners are called on whichever thread reported, so they must be quick and thread-safe.
